Sentence (English): I recently purchased a Bosch Series 4 built under dishwasher thinking installation would be a breeze.
Comments (English): [ Bosch Series 4 Dishwasher, an average performer ] || ---------------- || I recently purchased a Bosch Series 4 built under dishwasher thinking installation would be a breeze. While the kitchen cavity was adequate for the new unit, I wasn't prepared for the fact of having to secure the washer to prevent it tilting forward when the door was opened and the bottom basket slid out. There are small brackets included in the packaging which I find are impossible to fit and secure to the bench above. Herein lies the first problem. A few weeks later I'm still puzzled with what to do. The manual's diagrams are all but impossible to follow and You Tube videos are of little help with my problem.I must say that the machine runs very silently, however the "Quick' cycle takes one hour and another 17 minutes for 'Extra dry". Water remains on the unit floor which still emits a strong plastic odour after weeks of daily usage.If purchasing any dishwasher again i would want to examine the layout of the two drawers. Bosch designers haven't done their homework when designing this model's drawers. The bottom cutlery basket limits space for plates and dishes and consequently now sits in my garage. A useless piece of nothing.The top drawer has a permanent hinged knife tray that blocks access for cups and mugs. It shouldn't be too difficult designing something for easy, practical use. At the recommended retail price I'm sure you can do better.

Sentence (English): I bought this after our ancient dishwasher finally bit the dust.
Comments (English): [ Pleasantly surprised at how quiet it is! ] || ---------------- || I bought this after our ancient dishwasher finally bit the dust. We used it until it wasn't cleaning anymore and it was so loud from old parts and vibrating in its space that it kept everyone awake at night on a different floor of the house than the unit itself. Our requirement for our new dishwasher was that it have a stainless steel tub to reduce plastics. This was the cheapest option that Costco offered that had a stainless steel tub at the time we purchased. Now, there is still plastic on plenty of this unit but that just seems like the nature of everything you can buy these days and we also didn't want to spend more than $1k for top of the line units (no clue if they have less plastic - they weren't an option for our budget so we didn't even bother researching that). In fact, for a good week or so of running it nearly daily, it stunk to high heaven like petroleum as the plastic off-gassed. It freaked me out at first but after googling I found that it is normal (unfortunate reality). Really not the ideal situation when you're trying to eliminate plastic and toxins and know that stink is putting plenty into the air to you're breathing. After that though, it stopped stinking. It cleans well. It doesn't dry amazingly well, as it seems to leave the interior of the unit fairly “dewy” all over, so we keep it a little open to let it air dry some more. It's certainly not going to dry any plastic dishes if you have those, but I'm not sure any dishwasher is capable of that. Even though it doesn't have “quiet” in its title, it is VERY quiet. I don't notice the sound much at all and I'm quite sensitive to sound. Now, ANY new unit would be quieter than the one we had, and that's why we didn't even bother with the increased pricing on units that were advertised as quiet. So we were super pleasantly surprised by it! It does do the LG jingle that their washer/dryers make when it's complete so if you're a light sleeper and sleep near your kitchen, you may want to consider that. But I'd definitely recommend the unit overall. And the Costco installation and haul away was great - no issues there.

Now, there is still plastic on plenty of this unit but that just seems like the nature of everything you can buy these days and we also didn’t want to spend more than $1k for top of the line units (no clue if they have less plastic - they weren’t an option for our budget so we didn’t even bother researching that). In fact, for a good week or so of running it nearly daily, it stunk to high heaven like petroleum as the plastic off-gassed. It freaked me out at first but after googling I found that it is normal (unfortunate reality). Really not the ideal situation when you’re trying to eliminate plastic and toxins and know that stink is putting plenty into the air to you’re breathing. After that though, it stopped stinking. It cleans well. It doesn’t dry amazingly well, as it seems to leave the interior of the unit fairly “dewy” all over, so we keep it a little open to let it air dry some more. It’s certainly not going to dry any plastic dishes if you have those, but I’m not sure any dishwasher is capable of that. Even though it doesn’t have “quiet” in its title, it is VERY quiet. I don’t notice the sound much at all and I’m quite sensitive to sound. Now, ANY new unit would be quieter than the one we had, and that’s why we didn’t even bother with the increased pricing on units that were advertised as quiet. So we were super pleasantly surprised by it! It does do the LG jingle that their washer/dryers make when it’s complete so if you’re a light sleeper and sleep near your kitchen, you may want to consider that. But I’d definitely recommend the unit overall. And the Costco installation and haul away was great - no issues there.

It absolutely requires rinse aid to dry glassware and utensils. I hope this new unit gives me the same five years as the last.I do recommend this dishwasher. They no longer make the Tuscan stainless color, so if you're starting from scratch, I'd recommend buying plain old stainless, which seems to be the only color that remains in all manufacturer's line up. Sentence (English): Although we've only been using the Bosch dishwasher for a few days, the three days we've been using it regularly at home are a joy.
Comments (English): [ Silent, economical, efficient ] || ---------------- || Although we've only been using the Bosch dishwasher for a few days, the three days we've been using it regularly at home are a joy. We just need to get used to the layout of the cutlery tray, the modularity of the second tray, and the ability to retract the plate racks, which makes the appliance so versatile that sometimes we don't even know how to start arranging it until we get used to it.
Comments (Original): [ Silencioso, ahorrativo, eficiente ] || ---------------- || Aunque aún son pocos los días utilizando el lavavajillas Bosch, los tres que en casa lo usamos habitualmente estamos contentos. Es eficiente: ya se ve desde el día que se recibió en casa el bajón en consumo en las estadísticas de la distribuidora eléctrica. Solo tenemos que terminar de hacernos a la distribucion de la bandeja de cubiertos, a la modularidad de la segunda bandeja, o la posibilidad de escamotear soportes de platos, que hace tan versátil el aparato que aún hay veces que no sabes cómo empezar a colocarlo, hasta que no nos acostumbremos.

Sentence (English): We've had this for about a month.
Comments (English): [ Does the job pretty well ] || ---------------- || We've had this for about a month. I'm trying different settings, but so far my husband isn't too happy that it doesn't dry all the way. The smell. My old GE dishwasher I never had a problem with. I use Norwex dishwasher cleaner and rinse aid. Washer was 25 years old. I only replaced it to match with our new stove. Anyway, the smell was horrible and sour. I cleaned the filter. I ran regular sized loads. Same strong smell that lingered. It was not manufacturing or installation smell. That went away after 2 washes. I decided to try the Finish dishwasher detergent pod sample they included. BIG MISTAKE! While that sour smell was gone I was overcome with Finish smell. The pod left all my plastic smelling strongly of that stuff. I went to get a glass of water to drink and the water tasted terrible. I had to rinse all my dishes before using them.The smell won't come out of my plastic lids or Silicone spatula and splatter lids. I went back to my Norwex detergent. I hope the smell won't come back. At least there was no funky chemicals lingering when using Norwex detergent. Also, the top rack for silverware. It sometimes leaves spots or food stuck where the plastic shelf holds and touches the silverware. I have city water. I have used Auto wash cycle. Then tried Eco And Crystal dry. I can deal with the somewhat wet shelves, but I admit, my old dishwasher still worked and I didn't have that much water left behind and no smells whatsoever. I do like the power of the Bosch dishwasher and cleaning heavily soiled pots. Plates and bowls clean very nice as well. I appreciate not having to pre-rinse, only scrape foods off. We accidentally hit the power on button sometimes when closing it. Just need to be more aware of where we touch it. It is easy to clean on the outside. I use a damp microfiber cloth to wipe fingerprints off. It looks great outside. I like the 3 shelves for dishes and ability to adjust the shelves. I got the app after I had it for over a week. I like it, but I thought there was a way to set a timer for the dishwasher to start. I can't find it if it is available. I love the cute sound it makes when turning on and when it's done washing dishes.

Sentence (English): We went with this model based on the Consumer Reports review.
Comments (English): [ Nice dishwasher, nice features, but could be bette ] || ---------------- || We went with this model based on the Consumer Reports review. It was easy to install and overall we are satisfied with its features and with it's performance cleaning dishes, pots, jars, utensiles, etc. However, the rack design simply doesn't work well with our assortment of dishes, pots, etc., as compared with the Kenmore dishwashers we have had in the past. One might put that down to what we are familiar with, and that might be part of the problem. But I am certain that I would not have bought this dishwasher had I known of what I judge to be a genuinely poorly designed dish rack layout. I recommend potential buyers look closely to see wether they think this will work for their typical population of dishes, pots, etc. The separate utensil rack seems to me a waste of space and an additional and time-consuming bother to use. A second weakness of this product is the non-intuitive user interface both on the machine itself and via the app. I like having the app, especially to know when the wash cycle will be complete, but it is not easy or intuitive to use. This is a fine dishwasher that we expect to own for many years. But I urge buyers to look closely at the rack designs (for each of the three racks) and to be ready for a slow learning process for the interface and app.

Sentence (English): I needed to replace my dishwasher in an "All Viking" kitchen because the Viking dishwasher is just bad.
Comments (English): [ NOT WHAT I EXPECTED! ] || ---------------- || I needed to replace my dishwasher in an "All Viking" kitchen because the Viking dishwasher is just bad. The Bosch 800 fit the bill because is has no logo in the front and with its handle looks that it can pass for a Viking. There are some good things about this washer that I appreciate, such as cleaning power and quiet. However, I am very disappointed by few shortcomings that can be blamed on the lack of practicalities in this German piece of engineering: 1. The loading trays are not practical a bit; we have had Kitchen Aid, Kenmore, and even Viking dishwashers whose trays can accommodate dishes much better than this Bosch.2. When you program a wash, all the control are invisible once you close the door; the only time you have an indicating red light is when it turns on. There is no indicator to let you know that it finished washing, or it is in a delay mode. You may run the App to check the status of the dishwasher, but why not have a green light when the dishwasher finishes washing and an orange light confirming that the dishwasher is in delay mode? I would be reluctant to recommend this to a friend. Next time, I will play close attention to the loading trays to make sure they make sense!

Sentence (English): Given the history of solid reviews of the 800 series's best-in-class capabilities (high cleaning efficacy, low noise level, innovative rack design, reliability), there were no surprises.
Comments (English): [ High expectations, all met ] || ---------------- || Given the history of solid reviews of the 800 series's best-in-class capabilities (high cleaning efficacy, low noise level, innovative rack design, reliability), there were no surprises. Installation and operation were straightforward, helped by the clear documentation. Several runs have proven that it cleans well and is remarkably quiet. The only complaint I have is with the rather archaic water supply hookup, in which a brass female elbow adapter attaches, using a standard 5/8" hose thread, to a plastic male hose fitting on the machine. Hose fittings are unreliable, with just a bump on the elbow being enough to loosen them and cause a leak, which happened to me almost immediately. The instructions caution against using tools to tighten it, but the only way to make it more reliable is to tighten it 1/8 to 1/4 turn past hand-tight with a slip-joint pliers, which flirts with over-stressing the plastic fitting. A much better attachment would be via a 3/8" compression fitting (in stainless steel, not plastic), which these days is pretty much the standard for easy and reliable connection of felxible supply lines.

Sentence (English): I bought a kitchen full of GE appliances in 2021 (Fridge, microwave, gas range, dishwasher).
Comments (English): [ Very short lifetime. ] || ---------------- || I bought a kitchen full of GE appliances in 2021 (Fridge, microwave, gas range, dishwasher). Now, barely 4 years later my $900 dishwasher (PDT715SYNFS) doesn't run. Like another reviewer, mine randomly stops, but can't complete a cycle. Had the controller board replaced (~$200) and still no luck. All the diagnostics say it's fine, but it doesn't run. I'm disappointed beyond measure. I don't think most people expect to pay this much for a 4 year lifetime. Now I'm extremely worried about the longevity of every appliance in my kitchen. I wonder if companies realize the true cost of poor quality. With this kind of unreliability, you lose repeat customers. It costs the manufacturer far more than the cost of the cheap part that fails.

Comments (English): [ These days, having three generations of aunts in a household is the norm. ] || ---------------- || I hesitated about buying a dishwasher, but I decided to purchase one based on recommendations from acquaintances who said it’s standard practice to have three generations of aunts in the household. It is larger than I expected, and it feels like my sink has become a bit cramped. Using it is as easy as a washing machine; you just put in the dishes and detergent, press start, and it does everything automatically. However, perhaps because I haven't gotten used to it yet, arranging the dishes like Tetris is a bit difficult. Each detergent is designed to wash away grease and food residue, but no matter how strong the chemical component, high-pressure water cannot wash away stuck rice grains or bone fragments. The dishwasher also washes in this order: cold water -> warm water -> hot water. HIGHLY recommend

Sentence (English): I had an Electrolux Dishwasher for 15 years and it actually needed replacing several years ago.
Comments (English): [ Absolutely Amazing! ] || ---------------- || I had an Electrolux Dishwasher for 15 years and it actually needed replacing several years ago. My appliance repairman said to replace it with a BOSCH Dishwasher. I am so glad that I listened to him. I am truly enjoying my new BOSCH 500 Series Dishwasher. At first I wasn't sure if I would like the silverware flat pullout which is located above the top pull out, however I really do. The silverware and other utensils come out clean and there is plenty of room for them. It seems as if it is even easier to unload the silverware. I was very skeptical if I could actually load dirty dishes without rinsing them off first. I put it to the test with cheesy lasagna dishes. I could not believe that they came out totally clean. It is a quiet dishwasher but not totally silent. You can sometimes hear a slight hum at times and you can hear the water spining around at times. Neither of these sounds are loud . I do find that some plastic glasses may not come out totally dry especially if they happen to have a little dip in the bottom of the glass. However, actual glass plates, glasses and other dishes come out dry. The silverwear tray and the tray underneath that tray is adjustable to allow for additional room for different size items. I am very pleased that I selected this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): Honest Review: Bosch 100 Series Dishwasher for a Family Home After months of dealing with a noisy, unreliable dishwasher, we finally upgraded to the Bosch 100 Series Dishwasher, and overall, it's been a great addition to our busy household.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || Honest Review: Bosch 100 Series Dishwasher for a Family Home After months of dealing with a noisy, unreliable dishwasher, we finally upgraded to the Bosch 100 Series Dishwasher, and overall, it's been a great addition to our busy household. With three kids, constant meals, and never-ending dishes, we needed something reliable, spacious, and (most importantly) quiet. Here's my take on it after using it for a while. What We Love: ✅ Super Quiet – With little kids running around, nap time is sacred in our house. Thankfully, this dishwasher is whisper-quiet compared to our old one. At around 48-50 dBA, you can barely hear it unless you're standing right next to it. I can actually run it after dinner without worrying about waking anyone up. ✅ Gets the Job Done – Even after spaghetti nights and sticky peanut butter sandwiches, our dishes come out sparkling clean. Bosch's PrecisionWash™ technology really does a good job of adjusting to how dirty the dishes are, so I don't have to pre-rinse everything (which saves time and water). ✅ Spacious & Family-Friendly Layout – I love how much I can fit in here! The adjustable upper rack is a game-changer when I need to fit taller water bottles or big mixing bowls. The silverware basket is also well-designed, so even my kids' small utensils get cleaned properly. ✅ Energy & Water Efficient – Since we run our dishwasher daily (sometimes twice a day), it was important for us to have something ENERGY STAR® certified. I've already noticed a slight drop in our water usage, which is a nice bonus! A Few Downsides: ❌ Drying Could Be Better – This model doesn't have a heating element, so plastics tend to stay wet unless I crack the door open after the cycle. Not a dealbreaker, but something to keep in mind if you hate towel-drying. ❌ Takes a While to Finish – The regular cycle is pretty long (2+ hours), which isn't ideal when I need dishes quickly. Luckily, there's a Speed60 setting that helps when I'm in a rush. Final Thoughts: If you're looking for a reliable, quiet, and spacious dishwasher that can handle the daily chaos of a family home, the Bosch 100 Series is a solid pick. It may not have all the fancy features of higher-end models, but it cleans well, saves energy, and is quiet enough to run anytime. As long as you don't mind cracking the door open for better drying, it's a great family-friendly option! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4/5 stars) Would I buy it again? Yes! It's been a lifesaver in our kitchen.

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher on the recommendation of my son.
Comments (English): [ Stylish, good-looking dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher on the recommendation of my son. There were a few minor issues connecting to our Wi-Fi, but thanks to clear and easy-to-understand instructions, it eventually worked quickly and easily. I'm impressed by the cutlery rack at the top of the dishwasher. This ensures that the cutlery always gets thoroughly clean. What I don't really recommend are the foldable spikes to make more space for things like pots and pans. The programming of my favorite program is a great feature. The dishwasher is very quiet, which my previous model wasn't. Even in the short program, everything gets clean and, what's not really important, it also gets really dry. I'm completely satisfied with my appliance and will happily recommend it to others.
Comments (Original): [ Stielvoller gut aussehender Geschirrspüler ] || ---------------- || Ich habe mir diesen Geschirrspüler auf Empfehlung von meinem Sohn gekauft. Diw Einprogramierung von meinem Lieblingsprogramm ist eine tolle Sache. Der Geschirrspüler ist sehr leise ,was mein Vorgänger nicht an sich hatte.Selvst im kurz Programm wird alles sauber und was nich sehr wichtig ist auch richtig trocken. Ich bin rundherum zufrieden mit meinem Gerät und werde diesen gerne weiterempfehlen.
